primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

wikipediaRead.title: Tubal
wikipediaRead.locator: L131. Article identifies Tubal in Genesis 10 as a son of Japheth; the statement is limited to that genealogical relation.
